subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard permanently expose and retain the opt-in `status_changed` notification contract, including its stable replay identifiers and transition-history storage lifecycle?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible and tested design, but it expands the exported plugin notification API and introduces durable retained state; code review cannot choose whether that long-lived product contract is desired.

options.title: Approve the opt-in contract
options.body: Accept `status_changed` as a permanent Workboard notification kind with durable replay and the documented explicit subscription requirement.

options.title: Narrow the product contract
options.body: Require an owner-defined retention or consumption policy before merge if permanent transition history is not intended.

options.title: Defer the producer
options.body: Keep the PR open until a concrete downstream consumer or Workboard roadmap decision sponsors the new durable event.

recommendation.title: Approve the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept `status_changed` as a permanent Workboard notification kind with durable replay and the documented explicit subscription requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent repository work on SQLite-only runtime ownership and upgrade-safe migrations makes this the closest available product and storage-contract routing candidate.
